clips.title: The story
paras: Defias brigands have driven Milly Osworth from the Northshire vineyards. Her harvest lies scattered in buckets and crates among the occupied rows, where it may be stolen or crushed.

Milly Osworth fled the southeastern fields of Northshire Valley when Defias brigands swarmed the vines. She left her gathered grapes behind in buckets and crates among the occupied rows. Northshire's garrison is stretched thin, and Milly fears that boots and fighting will crush any fruit the bandits leave behind.

Defias bandits now occupy working vineyards, a sign of how little safety Northshire can offer. Stormwind's attention is elsewhere, and the valley has too few guards. Farmers like Milly must depend on recruits and wanderers to protect their property and secure the food and wine that supply the abbey.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting! I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes! If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.
Please, you must help me! I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.
Bring me those crates! Save my harvest!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my harvest, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh thank you, friend! You saved my harvest! And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.
We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
